description: Implementation of the Maternal and Early Childhood Nutrition Services Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been reported that the nutritional status of vulnerable population groups had declined due to certain factors associated with the economic crisis that emerged in the country following the Covid - 19 pandemic. This situation has become a serious problem in Districts of Nuwara Eliya, Rathnapura, Polonnaruwa and Trincomalee in particular. Therefore, it has been planned to implement a project to enhance the access to the selected community-based nutrition interventions in respect of pregnant and lactating women and all children under 05 years of age in such Districts. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the Maternal and Early Childhood Nutrition Services Project for a period of 03 years under a Grant of US$ 2.73 of the Japan Social Development Fund of the World Bank Group for a period of 03 years, was approved by the Cabinet.
